# Francophone anticolonial encounter

Fanon’s situated racial-colonial inquiry retains its own speaking position. The Antilles and metropolitan French encounter are historical conditions of language, gaze and recognition. The 1952 French work and its subsequent electronic carrier are distinct from any unselected English translation.

The [geographical route](../../atlas/geography/README.md) and [temporal route](../../atlas/temporality/README.md) **returns-to** these same wholes.
